name: The Gift Of Healing
overview: The Gift of Healing, as demonstrated in Luke and Acts, is a divine empowerment given by Christ to His followers, enabling them to command unclean spirits and cure diseases with authority and power. Jesus not only healed the multitudes who came to Him but also entrusted His disciples with the ability to heal, reflecting the grace and spiritual gifts distributed among believers. This gift is part of the variety of spiritual gifts granted according to God's grace, emphasizing faith's role in exercising such gifts for His glory.
